page.layout: One column of index entries under the running head "I N D E X.", with section letters (D., E., F., H.) set as separate lines. Left margin shows only red stains and the cut-off edge of the neighbouring page. Bottom-left shows show-through. Bottom right has the catchword "He-".
page.notes: Left margin: red staining and the cut-off edge of the neighbouring page (fragments such as "conic", "rcitia") are not printed text here and are left out. Bottom-left "Fu" and the marks beside it are show-through, left out. Greek accents on "Εἵλωτες" and "Εὔθυνοι" are read with doubt and marked [?]. "Exercitia" has its initial E hidden by the margin edge and is marked [?]. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The hyphen in "desi-" is a doubtful reading of "defi-" with a long s. No page number is printed.
